items.html:
A founder hounder is a term used to describe individuals or investors who pursue startup founders for specific motives, most commonly referring to: 
  • In Dating and Culture: People (historically nicknamed "Twags" or founder-hounders) who specifically target, date, or marry wealthy Silicon Valley tech founders, executives, or startup CEOs for status, wealth, or proximity to success. 
  • In Business and Investing: Aggressive investors or intermediaries who relentlessly pressure early-stage startup founders to sell equity, accept unfavorable terms, or exit prematurely using persistent, coercive tactics.
